_about: Controlled vocabulary and the mental model the dashboard draws. Signals must use these ids. Change this file only when the picture itself changes (a new layer, a new way of producing optimisations) and say so in the cycle record.

layers.name: Optimisation loop
layers.desc: The agents, harnesses and scoreboards that produce optimisations. Nothing here serves a token; it decides what the layers below become.

layers.name: Routing & orchestration
layers.desc: Which model, worker or deployment configuration a request is sent to.

layers.name: Serving & scheduling
layers.desc: Batching, the prefill/decode split, KV-cache placement, eviction and transfer across a cluster.

layers.name: Model-level
layers.desc: Changes to the weights or the decoding procedure: quantisation, distillation, speculative decoding, post-training.

layers.name: Engine & runtime
layers.desc: The forward-pass executor and its configuration: vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, llama.cpp, MLX.

layers.name: Compiler
layers.desc: Graph capture, fusion decisions and code generation between the model definition and the kernels.

layers.name: Kernels
layers.desc: The GPU programs themselves: attention, MoE dispatch, GEMM, sampling, cache packing, on one specific chip.

layers.name: Hardware
layers.desc: Accelerators and their memory and network topology.

mechanisms.name: Hand-tuned
mechanisms.desc: A human performance engineer writes or configures it.

mechanisms.name: Compiler rules
mechanisms.desc: Fixed heuristics or cost models generate it. Deterministic, no learning from the deployment.

mechanisms.name: Online adaptive
mechanisms.desc: The running system adjusts itself from live signals. No new code is written; a planner or controller moves knobs.

mechanisms.name: Agent search
mechanisms.desc: LLM agents propose code or configuration, a harness measures it, winners are kept. New code is written.

mechanisms.name: Scoreboard / analysis
mechanisms.desc: Benchmarks, critiques and essays. They optimise nothing, but they set what counts as winning.

venues.name: Shared cloud
venues.desc: Multi-tenant serverless clusters run by an inference provider.

venues.name: Dedicated endpoint
venues.desc: Single-tenant cloud capacity tuned for one customer.

venues.name: On-prem / private
venues.desc: Hardware the operator owns, in their own rack.

venues.name: Local device
venues.desc: A laptop, workstation, phone or small box owned by the user.

timescales.name: Per request
timescales.desc: Routing a request to the worker that already holds its cache; choosing how far to speculate for this token.

timescales.name: Per traffic shift
timescales.desc: Re-splitting a cluster between prefill and decode; deciding which cached context to evict.

timescales.name: Per hillclimb
timescales.desc: Agents rewriting kernels and engine paths against recorded traffic, or a model or drafter retrained from live use, then promoting the winners.

timescales.name: Per model or chip
timescales.desc: Bringing up a new architecture or accelerator on day zero.

loop.name: Observe
loop.does: Record what real traffic looks like: context lengths, cache hits, time per kernel.
loop.hard: Only whoever serves the traffic sees it, unless a public trace set stands in.

loop.name: Propose
loop.does: Agents write candidate kernels, engine patches or settings.
loop.hard: Cheap, and getting cheaper. A plain instruction has beaten expert-written playbooks.

loop.name: Evaluate
loop.does: Measure each candidate on realistic inputs, end to end, and check outputs still match.
loop.hard: Synthetic inputs and isolated benchmarks give wrong answers. Nobody can yet simulate traffic they have not seen.

loop.name: Promote
loop.does: Ship winners to production and, often, upstream to the open engine.
loop.hard: People still review what ships, and patches now arrive faster than they can read them.

loop.name: Reflect
loop.does: Revise the agents' own process from what failed.
loop.hard: Everyone names it as the goal. Almost no one has shown it. This step is what would make the loop recursive.

now.label: Now: a search
steps: Agents rewrite code; trainers update weights
A rig measures end to end
Winners ship, or swap in live
now.loop: repeats per task, per workload, per model and chip
